design_notes: The trip is on a Department of Defense award: the Fly America Act applies (1055-1058) and the Open Skies exception does not (1092-1093); United and Delta have seats, add 185 and 170 minutes to the trip, and connect in the United States, so no exception of 1081-1090 applies, and ticket cost is no exception (1094-1095). The lowest U.S. carrier fare: United via Newark, 86500.
